name: Activities, Games & Sports
desc: Indoor games, outdoor sports, adrenaline activities and swimming.

subcategories.name: Bowling
subcategories.needs: Reserve actual bowling lanes by party size and time. Set lane capacity, game duration and equipment terms.

subcategories.name: Arcade & timed play
subcategories.needs: Set timed entry capacity, age guidance and equipment availability.

subcategories.name: Escape rooms
subcategories.needs: Reserve an exclusive room for the party. Set age limits, duration and reset time.

subcategories.name: Indoor sports courts
subcategories.needs: Reserve a compatible indoor court by sport, duration and group size.

subcategories.name: Outdoor sports courts
subcategories.needs: Reserve a compatible court and define rain or unsafe-surface cancellation terms.

subcategories.name: Football pitches
subcategories.needs: Reserve a pitch by size, availability and playing time. Set floodlight and equipment terms.

subcategories.name: Outdoor team games
subcategories.needs: Schedule dated team sessions with participant limits, equipment and supervision.

subcategories.name: Go-karting
subcategories.needs: Manage heat capacity, available karts and marshals. Record height, age and safety briefing requirements.

subcategories.name: Paintball
subcategories.needs: Schedule games with player capacity, protective equipment and briefing requirements.

subcategories.name: Ziplining & high ropes
subcategories.needs: Review party size, age and weight limits, operator supervision and weather before offering a confirmed slot.

subcategories.name: Public swim sessions
subcategories.needs: Set timed pool capacity, lifeguard cover and supervision requirements.

subcategories.name: Swimming lessons
subcategories.needs: Match the swimmer to an eligible instructor, suitable pool space and lesson duration.

subcategories.name: Pool lane hire
subcategories.needs: Reserve the actual lane and time. Set party size, allowed use and pool supervision terms.
